summary: On desktop the own profile split into three unequal columns (identity card about 230px tall, Playing now about 200px, Friends and Settings about 260px), leaving ragged bottoms; the narrow middle column truncated "Hosting Quick connect …" and the narrow third column wrapped the Settings caption to three lines. The profile now composes as a compact identity band over a flexible main column (Playing now) and a 24rem rail (Friends, Settings) whose captions fit on one line.
